# Legacy code vocabulary that must not appear in generated output for arbitrary households.
#
# No fixture portfolio uses any of these terms, so a hit in a rendered dashboard, an LLM
# wire payload or a generated artefact indicates a hardcoded parser/schema literal leaking
# out of the code rather than coming from the configured portfolio data.
#
# Developer-specific household terms can be placed in the gitignored `Data/.household_terms`
# file, which `tests/support/roots.py` merges automatically when running outside isolated
# fixture roots.
#
# Matching is word-boundary and case-insensitive (see tests/support/scans.py).

# --- legacy default equity / stock-plan schema tokens ------------------------
GOOG
GOOGL
Alphabet
Google
GSU
GSUs

# --- built-in custodian parser labels that must not leak onto other FIs ------
Wells Fargo
WFA
WFB
Morgan Stanley
MSSB
StockPlan Connect
UMA
